executive_summary: On August 8, 2026, OFAC added 18 entities and individuals to the SDN list, primarily targeting Iranian and UAE-based entities involved in sanctions evasion and terrorist activities. Eight entities were removed from the list, mostly Mexican individuals and companies previously designated under the SDNTK program. No updates were made to existing listings.

notable_entities.name: Aban Tether Exchange
notable_entities.significance: Designated for providing financial services to Iranian entities, highlighting the ongoing efforts to evade sanctions

notable_entities.name: CRYPTO HOME DMCC
notable_entities.significance: Added to the SDN list for involvement in terrorist activities, demonstrating the growing concern over cryptocurrency-based transactions

notable_entities.name: Kayvanpour Siavash
notable_entities.significance: Designated as a key figure in terrorist activities, with multiple aliases and cryptocurrency wallets

risk_implications.description: The addition of 18 new entities and individuals to the SDN list highlights the ongoing efforts to evade sanctions, particularly in the Middle East and cryptocurrency sectors
The designation of entities involved in terrorist activities underscores the need for enhanced due diligence and monitoring of transactions, particularly those involving cryptocurrency
The removal of eight entities from the SDN list may indicate a decrease in sanctions risk for certain Mexican individuals and companies, but continued vigilance is necessary

program_highlights.note: The majority of additions were related to the IRAN-EO13902 program, targeting Iranian entities and individuals involved in sanctions evasion
The SDGT program saw significant additions, primarily focusing on entities and individuals involved in terrorist activities

compliance_recommendations: Enhance due diligence and monitoring of transactions, particularly those involving cryptocurrency
Conduct regular reviews of customer and vendor lists to ensure compliance with updated sanctions lists
Implement robust sanctions screening and filtering processes to prevent transactions with designated entities
